programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.title: Dead Before Dawn
programme.desc: Dead Before Dawn is a Canadian horror comedy that puts a fresh spin on the zombie genre with high-energy antics, supernatural mayhem, and a hefty dose of self-aware humor. The film follows awkward college student Casper Galloway, who reluctantly agrees to watch over his grandfather’s mysterious occult shop while his mother attends an award ceremony. Surrounded by oddities and ancient relics, Casper inadvertently unleashes a powerful curse when a mysterious skull-topped urn is broken. The curse is no ordinary one: anyone who makes eye contact with Casper and his group is doomed to take their own life, only to rise again as a bizarre hybrid of zombie and demon—dubbed a “zemon.” As zemons begin to spread at an alarming rate, the once-ordinary day spirals into a chaotic fight for survival. Casper, along with a ragtag group of college friends, must piece together the right ingredients for a reversal ritual before sunrise. With a confined Winnebago as their base of operations, the group frantically scours local haunts—from gas stations to graveyards—evading their monstrous pursuers while battling inner doubts and interpersonal tension. The film cleverly balances outrageous gore with slapstick comedy, meta-horror references, and quirky character dynamics. Veteran actor Christopher Lloyd adds flair as Casper’s eccentric grandfather, offering both exposition and comic relief. The story concludes with a time-reversing ritual that nearly restores normalcy—until the urn is seen teetering again, hinting at another disaster. Bold, bizarre, and unapologetically fun, it’s a cult gem for lover of genre mashups.
